entry.title: Strong Wind Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Severe gale west to southwesterlies gusting 120 km/h in exposed places. Note, after the warning period ends, westerlies are expected to remain at gale force in exposed places into Sunday evening. Impact: Damage to trees, powerlines, and unsecured structures possible. Driving may be difficult, especially for high-sided vehicles and motorcycles. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal. Changes: Watch upgraded to an Orange Warning.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Strong Wind Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Severe gale westerlies gusting 120 km/h in exposed places, especially south of Gore. Note, after the warning period ends, westerlies are expected to remain at gale force in exposed places into Sunday evening. Impact: Damage to trees, powerlines, and unsecured structures possible. Driving may be difficult, especially for high-sided vehicles and motorcycles. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Low. Changes: Warning area expanded to include all of Southland and also Fiordland.

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 70 to 100 mm of rain on top of what has already fallen. Peak rates of 15 to 25 mm/h expected and thunderstorms possible. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: On top of what has already fallen, expect 80 to 100 mm of rain about the main divide, and 60 to 80 mm within 20 km farther east. Peak rates of 10 to 20 mm/h about the divide. Thunderstorms possible Sunday morning. Freezing level about 2100 metres, lowering to 1400 metres Sunday morning. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal.
